project: Muhlnickel weightless one-file speaking Titan; not Kaggriculture Titan or Kaggle/ARC

callable_signatures: png(path, w, h, data, gray=False, depth=8)
tools.read_write_roles: Reads source files; never changes source. Writes PNG for rendering/visual modes and text manifest for manifest mode. Other modes print to stdout. manifest and watch --full are whole-file streaming paths; static summaries generally read the requested source window into memory.
tools.large_file_support: --offset/--len bounds in-memory modes. manifest streams the entire file in default 4 MiB chunks and emits one hash/nonzero count per chunk. watch --full streams full passes in default 1 MiB chunks and is bounded-memory. map streams full file by chunks. strip is stratified sampling: up to 4096 columns with at most 65536 bytes read per column, not 100% coverage. watch without --full samples windows; with one probe and no --len it can retain whole snapshots in memory. dag/levels/step load the selected window and materialize records/graph; set --len on large inputs.
tools.artifact_outputs: PNG, .mf manifest, or console metrics/listings depending on mode.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: read-only live byte surface, tile atlas and host-write journal observer
tools.cli: python muhl_live_backend.py [--port 7881] [--fanout 4096] [--chunk-mb 8] [--path PATH] [--registry PATH] [--journal-glob GLOB] [--no-baseline] [--no-sweep] [--sweep --sweep-hz HZ]
callable_signatures: Surface(path, registry_path, fanout, chunk_bytes, journal_glob=..., sweep_hz=..., sweep_enabled=False, baseline_enabled=True)
tools.read_write_roles: Opens titan.gguf `rb` and mmap.ACCESS_READ, registry `r`, journals `rb`; backend source never writes binary/registry/journal. `--no-baseline` prevents the startup full-file reduction pass. It still mmap maps the binary, starts a Windows ReadDirectoryChangesW watcher and JournalWatcher, and the journal glob is periodically re-enumerated on notification/watchdog; first sight gets file sizes and sets cursors to EOF, existing history is skipped. On new appended journal rows, it reads only appended journal bytes (8 MiB/file/wakeup cap) and targeted binary ranges (4 MiB/apply/wakeup cap).
tools.large_file_support: Read-only mmap over current file plus fixed-size chunk buffer. At default fanout4096, tile_count about4096 for this file; two XOR signature planes are 2*4096*4096 bytes ≈32 MiB, plus 8 MiB chunk buffer and bounded arrays/caches. `--no-baseline` avoids full-file startup read but still maps file and allocates those arrays. Default mode does one whole-file baseline pass at startup (historically estimated ~868 s for 93.7GB); repeating sweep is opt-in `--sweep`.
tools.artifact_outputs: HTTP JSON/SSE only. No output files are written by backend source.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.read_write_roles: Opens binary `rb` and registry `r` only; outputs JSON interpretation records. No API exists from the live_viewer HTML to call this Python engine; the page's panel is separate local JavaScript aggregation.
tools.large_file_support: Does not stream the whole file. Range sample max is 65,536 bytes; stride check capped at 64 records; marker sample max 65,536 bytes. It also parses GGUF header/tensor table and reads a fixed 24-byte global intake header. Registry is loaded wholly and cached. Header read counter ceiling is 32 MiB, though parser reads through declared metadata/tensors table rather than enforcing a hard stop.
tools.artifact_outputs: Structured interpretation record list/JSON to stdout; `overhead()` reports host-side IO/RSS counters.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: browser UI entrypoint for the 7881 live byte/tile backend
tools.cli: Serve/open live_viewer.html with optional query parameters; `?api=http://127.0.0.1:PORT` overrides backend, `?stream=off` disables SSE in favor of polling.
tools.read_write_roles: Browser GETs status/tiles/bytes/regions and subscribes to SSE; POSTs `/api/observe_rate` only when Apply is clicked. It can download exported evidence JSON client-side and stores theme in browser localStorage. No binary/registry writes. On page load, `probe()` immediately requests status/tiles and opens SSE.
tools.large_file_support: Uses backend pyramid drill and bounded 256-byte-ish selected tile byte request. Keeps up to 600 history observations and 320 rain rows in page memory.
tools.artifact_outputs: Rendered UI; Export evidence JSON triggers browser download. No server-side output unless the user explicitly applies observation rate, which changes server rate only.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: bulk read-only byte range server for all_bits.html, with measurement-report sidecar endpoint
tools.read_write_roles: Source file opened `rb` and mmap.ACCESS_READ, fallback thread-local seek/read. GET data endpoints are read-only. POST `/report` writes `all_bits_measured.json` beside script and stores report in memory; the all_bits page posts that endpoint every second. Thus running bitserve plus that page enables sidecar persistence.
tools.large_file_support: mmap read-only with range reads capped at64 MiB. /overview reads one 128KiB row per output row; output pixels are literal sampled bits selected across file. It can serve bounded range windows from large files.
tools.artifact_outputs: HTTP range bytes and static web files; POST /report writes/overwrites all_bits_measured.json.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: literal-bit WebGL2 visualizer using bitserve plus 7881 journal stream
tools.read_write_roles: GETs `/info`, `/bytes`, `/overview` from 7883, and `/api/stream` plus `/api/bytes` verification samples from 7881. POSTs `snap` every second to bitserve `/report` (sidecar write). Does not write binary or registry.
tools.large_file_support: GPU texture ring of up to 256 layers, each 8192×8192 R8UI =64MiB; default asks 16 layers (1GiB). Each layer loads in 8MiB HTTP chunks with two layer jobs in flight. Whole-file overview requests selected sampled bits across the full file; the manual sweep rotates resident chunks through GPU. It is a visual sample at current zoom except overview mode.
tools.artifact_outputs: WebGL display and measurement report POST sidecar. No exported downloadable artifact other than bitserve report.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately
